short: an early, changeable API in a jdk.incubator.* module, enabled with --add-modules. the vector API has been one since java 16.
the record constructor that takes every component in order. the compact form validates without repeating the parameters or assignments.
a pattern variable exists exactly where the compiler can prove the match succeeded, even after if (!(o instanceof T t)) return;
a when clause on a switch case: case Integer i when i > 0. the case only matches if the pattern and the condition both hold.
a switch case that can never match because an earlier case always matches first. a compile error, not a warning.
a switch that covers every possible input. pattern switches must be; over a sealed type, a case per subtype is enough.
a pattern that matches a record and takes it apart into its components by calling the accessors: Point(int x, int y). they nest.
_ for a pattern, lambda parameter, catch variable or loop variable you have to declare but never use. java 22.
thrown when a pattern can't be decided at run time: an accessor threw, or a sealed hierarchy grew after the switch was compiled.
data built from products (records: this and that) and sums (sealed interfaces: this or that).
modelling data as immutable records under sealed interfaces, with behaviour in exhaustive pattern-matching switches.
classes make new types easy and new operations hard; switches over sealed data make it the other way around.
import module java.base; imports every public type in every package a module exports. java 25, allowed in any file.
java.lang.IO: println, print and readln for simple console programs, in every file without an import. java 25.
statements before super(...) or this(...): validate, prepare arguments and set your own fields before the superclass runs. java 25.
patterns, instanceof and switch for primitive types, matching only exact conversions: 1000 instanceof byte is false. preview in 27.
a value computed at most once, on first use, then treated like a constant. LazyConstant, preview in 27 (was StableValue in 25).
